title: Law to require notice before removing public trash cans
summary: This bill would stop the Department of Sanitation from removing a public litter basket solely because it was used for illegal dumping. It would require DSNY to notify the affected Council member and community board before removing a basket, giving them 10 business days to comment, and to consider those comments before acting. DSNY would also have to file a quarterly public report on the number and locations of baskets, removals and related littering complaints.
